remarks: Foxboro living at its finest! Fully updated two bedroom, two and a half bath townhouse condominium. With new carpets, a recently remodeled kitchen with Stainless steel appliances, quartz countertops, and tile back-splash, it creates a wonderful kitchen environment for cooking therapy at its best! The living room boasts a cozy fireplace surrounded by built-ins and sliders that take you out to your deck that showcases the privacy of Foxboro. The Master and second bedrooms are both en-suite on the upper level, with the master having soaring ceilings with skylights creating a bright atmosphere. The finished lower level is perfect for WFH office and/or a play area. A new washer and dryer and garage help round out this move-in-ready living experience. Located on the Wilton border, Foxboro offers convenient access to nearby shopping, dining, and commutation (minutes to the Merritt Parkway, 95, and metro-north)
